# xychart fixtures

- `sales-revenue.mmd`: the mermaid-svg 0.7.0 sample
  (https://github.com/xmiksay/mermaid/tree/v0.7.0/samples), MIT licensed;
  `docs-horizontal.mmd` is the same chart in the horizontal orientation
  from the Mermaid XY chart documentation
  (https://mermaid.js.org/syntax/xyChart.html), MIT licensed,
  © Knut Sveidqvist and contributors.
- `grouped-cjk.mmd`, `numeric-x.mmd`, `minimal.mmd`: written for this crate:
  grouped named bars, a legend, data labels, CJK, a numeric x range,
  negative values and an automatic axis.
